newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss Life starts trading at 549 francs.
newsitem.headline: Swiss Life starts trading at 549 francs.

text.p: Shares of insurance company Swiss Life/Rentenanstalt, in their first day of trading on the Swiss Bourse, opened at 549 francs per share.
The participation certificates had closed on Wednesday at 539 francs.
Members of the mutual insurance company Swiss Life/Rentenanstalt last month voted in favour of management's proposal to convert the group into a limited public company.
The transition into a public company became legally effective on June 30.

The transition will result in former members owning 53 percent of Swiss Life's share capital. Participation certificate holders will have eight percent and Union Bank of Switzerland 25 percent of the capital.
